title: Soviet Tank Pressure
openingSummary: POWR>BARR>PROC>WEAP>FIX; stream 3TNK with FTRK support; add a second WEAP when funded.
when: A usable land route exists and massed rocket infantry or mine walls are not confirmed.
avoidWhen: The opponent has a dense E3 screen, anti-tank mines, or an established artillery line.
opening: POWR > BARR > PROC with E1 scouts out early
WEAP as income allows, then FIX — the Service Depot gates tank production
First 3TNK immediately; add a second WEAP for a faster stream
Second PROC when the first wave rolls out
composition: 6-8 3TNK as the fist (twin 105mm, strong versus Heavy)
2-3 FTRK riding with the tanks — tank cannons cannot shoot air
Keep the E1 screen alive for vision, not combat
execution: queueMission sweep on the ore line and midmap before committing anywhere
spyPlane the target base right before each wave
guard the FTRK onto the tank squad so the AA umbrella travels
queueMission pincer posture=raid targetPriority=economy with 2-3 spare tanks
pursue on enemyRetreating and CRUSH rocket infantry under tracks instead of trading shots
reinforce the front squad with every fresh tank pair; setPolicy autoRepairBuildings=true

phases.name: mobilize
phases.objective: Reach a six-tank core without sacrificing scouting or anti-air coverage.

phases.name: pressure
phases.objective: Strike production with the main body and raid economy only with a bounded fast detachment.

abortTransitions.when: Two waves fail against confirmed anti-armor infantry, mines, or static guns.

claims.statement: The 3TNK is a heavy Soviet vehicle with two 105mm weapons and cannot attack air targets.
Rocket infantry deal full anti-heavy damage and are a material threat to unsupported tanks.
FTRK support covers the tank group's air-targeting gap but does not replace anti-infantry positioning.
Delay the second War Factory until the first tank stream and economy are stable.
When direct armor trades fail twice, convert to ranged siege instead of feeding another wave.
